disclaimer: Not financial advice. This page organizes public information for research purposes only — not a recommendation to buy or sell any security. Verify current prices and do your own due diligence before investing.

private_watchlist.name: PsiQuantum
private_watchlist.note: Expanded DARPA agreement to $125M (Jul 22, 2026) — one of only two companies in Stage C, the final validation stage of DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative; targeting 1M-qubit system with Microsoft/NVIDIA/GlobalFoundries.

private_watchlist.name: Quantinuum
private_watchlist.note: Honeywell-backed; upsized $1.68B IPO raise at $60/share (~$12.7B valuation). New Rolls-Royce/Riverlane/Univ. of Edinburgh industrial-design pact (Jul 14) and SoftBank roadmap (Helios now → Sol 2027 → Apollo 2029 → Lumos 2030s fault tolerance).

private_watchlist.name: QuEra
private_watchlist.note: $230M+ raise backed by Google Quantum AI, SoftBank, NVentures; 96 verified logical qubits — industry-leading.

bear_case.title: Years from commercial advantage
bear_case.description: Most systems remain R&D-phase; revenue today is mostly government contracts and research access, not commercial workloads.

bear_case.title: Valuations price in perfection
bear_case.description: P/S of 109–836× means decades of flawless execution are already in the price; drawdowns of 50%+ are routine — IonQ/RGTI/QBTS fell 6-8% in a single session on Jul 13, 2026 amid broad risk-off selling.

bear_case.title: Insiders aren't buying
bear_case.description: Insiders at IonQ, Rigetti and D-Wave have collectively sold ~$988M in stock over five years versus under $4M in insider purchases combined (as of Jul 22, 2026) — a persistent gap between executive selling and executive conviction.

bear_case.title: Dilution as a business model
bear_case.description: Pure-plays fund R&D via repeated equity raises; share counts grow relentlessly. CHIPS Act awards to Rigetti, D-Wave and others are structured partly as government equity stakes — another layer of dilution on top.

bear_case.title: Winner may not be listed
bear_case.description: IBM/Google/Microsoft or private Quantinuum/PsiQuantum could reach fault tolerance first, stranding pure-play premiums.

catalysts.title: D-Wave moves its listing to Nasdaq
catalysts.description: D-Wave transfers its primary listing from NYSE to Nasdaq under the same QBTS ticker; CEO Alan Baratz rings the opening bell, aligning the stock with Nasdaq's tech-focused investor base.

catalysts.title: PsiQuantum expands DARPA deal to $125M
catalysts.description: New agreement under DARPA's Quantum Benchmarking Initiative; PsiQuantum is one of only two companies to reach Stage C, the program's final validation stage for utility-scale hardware claims.

catalysts.title: $988M insider-selling warning
catalysts.description: Five-year cumulative insider sales across IonQ, Rigetti and D-Wave top $988M against under $4M in insider buying combined — a fresh valuation-discipline flag from Wall St. commentary.

catalysts.title: Quantinuum partners with Rolls-Royce, Riverlane, Edinburgh
catalysts.description: Industrial design and simulation collaboration announced alongside a Quantinuum/SoftBank roadmap mapping use-case classes to hardware milestones: Helios (now) → Sol (2027) → Apollo (2029) → Lumos (2030s fault tolerance).

catalysts.title: Trump signs quantum executive orders
catalysts.description: Targets a "scientifically relevant" quantum computer by 2028 and accelerated federal migration to post-quantum cryptography; government took equity stakes in Rigetti and D-Wave as part of the CHIPS deal.

catalysts.title: $2.01B CHIPS quantum awards
catalysts.description: Commerce Dept signs letters of intent with 9 companies — IBM ($1B, new quantum foundry), GlobalFoundries ($375M), Rigetti/D-Wave/Quantinuum/PsiQuantum/Atom Computing ($100M each), Diraq ($38M).
